# LeViT

**Category:** Hybrid · **Code:**
[`timm/models/levit.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/levit.py) ·
**Architectures:** 20 · **Pretrained weights:** 10 (10 with ImageNet-1k results)

LeViT is a hybrid network for fast inference, a convolutional stem followed by attention stages that shrink the
resolution with attention based downsampling and use attention biases for position.

## Papers

* [LeViT: a Vision Transformer in ConvNet's Clothing for Faster Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.01136)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('levit_256.fb_dist_in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

## Model API support

| Feature | `Levit` | `LevitDistilled` |
|---|---|---|
| [`features_only=True` feature maps](../model_api#intermediate-features) | ✓ (strides 16, 32, 64) | ✓ (strides 16, 32, 64) |
| [`forward_intermediates()`](../model_api#intermediate-features) | ✓ | ✓ |
| [`prune_intermediate_layers()`](../model_api#intermediate-features) | ✓ | ✓ |
| [Any input size, no changes needed](../model_api#input-size) | ✗ | ✗ |
| [`set_input_size()`](../model_api#input-size) | ✗ | ✗ |
| [`dynamic_img_size=True`](../model_api#input-size) | ✗ | ✗ |
| [`set_grad_checkpointing()`](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✓ | ✓ |
| [Layer-wise LR decay (`group_matcher()`)](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✓ | ✓ |
| [`reset_classifier()`](../model_api#classifier) | ✓ | ✓ |

✓ supported, ✓ (square) works for square sizes only, ✗ not supported, – not needed (the model already accepts any input
size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`Levit` with `levit_256d` at 224,
`LevitDistilled` with `levit_128s` at 224), other architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See
the [Model API](../model_api) page for details.
